title: Aye Alamdaare Hussain
body:
Aye Alamdar E Hussain
Yaar E Gham Khwar E Hussain
Meer E Bazar E Hussain
Aaha Uftade Ze Tan Daste Alamdar E Hussain
Qalafe Sher E Khuda Yaar E Wafadaar E Hussain
1. Aah Zaoum Dam Ke Be Baa Keen E Beradar Ba Raseed, Aah'ieh Az Dil Ba Kasheed
Zedagi Nala'h O Shud Ho Shud E Guftar E Hussain
<<DIVIDER>>
2. Guftu Kaaein Quwat E Bazu E Rawan E Basaram, Az To Kham Shud Kamar'am
Chu Kunambaad To Aaein Sarwar E Salar E Hussain.
